input.summary: Insert new Section 11.4 requiring Commerce One to provide up to six months of transition assistance and to return, then certify deletion of, Corio and Customer data.
input.comment: [Playbook] Section 11 covers survival but gives us no exit path, so we have added a transition-assistance and data-return provision: up to six (6) months of assistance at Commerce One's then-current rates, return of our and our Customers' data in a machine-readable format within thirty (30) days, and certified deletion thereafter. If six months is an issue we can live with ninety (90) days of assistance, but we need the data return and deletion certificate.

ops.text: 11.4 Transition Assistance and Return of Data. Notwithstanding Section 11.3, upon expiration or termination of this Agreement for any reason, Commerce One shall, at Corio's request: (a) provide reasonable transition assistance, including continued access to the Software, the MarketSite.net Service and related support, as reasonably necessary for Corio to continue supporting its then-existing Customers and Software Users or to migrate them to an alternative solution, for a period of up to six (6) months at Commerce One's then-current rates; (b) within thirty (30) days of Corio's request, return or deliver to Corio all data of Corio, its Customers and Software Users then in Commerce One's possession or control, in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (c) thereafter delete such data from its systems and certify such deletion to Corio in writing.
